note: Dev's electrical business: invented for JOYSTICK's first-ten-minutes example of "The Estimate That Wouldn't Fit". Every address is on the reserved .example domain. See shared/firstTenMinutesExample.ts.

messages.subject: Electrical work at Avenue 54
messages.body:
Hi Dev,

We just bought 1418 Avenue 54 and there's a list. Could you look at the garage, the kitchen lighting and the upstairs hallway while you're out here? We'd like an EV charger in the garage eventually.

Thanks,
Marisol

messages.subject: Re: Electrical work at Avenue 54
messages.body:
Hi Marisol,

Congratulations on the house. Happy to look at all three. I only quote after a site visit, so I'll come by Thursday and put one estimate together for the lot. Does 9 work?

Dev Mistry
Northfield Electric · Highland Park

messages.subject: Hallway lights at York Commons
messages.body:
Hi Dev,

Could you take a look at the hallway lights at York Commons? Two fixtures on the second floor keep flickering.

Gabe Torres
Property Manager, York Commons
5021 York Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90042

messages.subject: Re: Hallway lights at York Commons
messages.body:
Hi Gabe,

I can be there Tuesday at 8. Will someone be on site to let me in?

Dev Mistry
Northfield Electric · Highland Park

messages.subject: Oven circuit
messages.body:
Hi Dev,

Our oven circuit keeps tripping. Could you come before we open on Saturday?

Priya Nair
The Figueroa Bakery
5609 N Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90042

messages.subject: Re: Oven circuit
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

I can do Friday at 6am, before your first bake. Is the back door the best way in?

Dev

messages.subject: Two kilns
messages.body:
Hi Dev,

We're adding two kilns to the studio. Can our panel handle it?

Luis Romero
Avenue 50 Studio
131 N Avenue 50, Los Angeles, CA 90042

messages.subject: Re: Two kilns
messages.body:
Hi Luis,

Probably, but I'd want to see the panel first. Could I stop by Monday morning?

Dev

messages.subject: Re: Electrical work at Avenue 54
messages.body:
Hi Dev,

Thanks again for coming by. Let's do the garage first; the house can wait. We'd like the charger in before the car arrives in December.

Marisol

messages.subject: Re: Electrical work at Avenue 54
messages.body:
Hi Marisol,

Makes sense. I'll send the estimate this week.

Dev
